page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Title "Marco Antonio Monlucio." at the head, then a six-line poem in italic. Then a second title, "Magdalenæ Scotorum Reginæ.", followed by a six-line poem in italic. Signature below it. Ornament and handwritten mark at the foot are not text.

p.i: Monluci,armata regeres ut frena cohortis, Supra annos virtus consiliumque dedit. Supra annos animi vis Martia perdidit ausum Obvia fulmineo pectora ferre globo. Quem super astantem muros prius horruit hostem, Postea defuncti vindicis ossa colit.

Certarunt totas in te edere, Magdali, vires, Natura, & virtus, gloria, morsque suas. Esse bonam tribuit virtus, Natura decoram, Esse brevis vitæ mors inimica dedit. Vivida perpetuum sed gloria floret in ævum, Ut penset vitam perpete laude brevem.

page.notes: Printed "Monluci" begins with a large M initial, joined to the word. Long s printed as f in "consilium" and "astantem" was transcribed as s. The "&" in "Natura, &" is kept as printed. Handwritten marks (a pencilled "ʋ ʌ" under the author name) and the printer's fleuron are not transcribed. Spellings "Obuia", "Viuida", "breuis", "breuem" and "Vt" were changed to u/v and i/j conventions as the rules require. No doubtful readings.
